manual: Runs models as rootless Podman containers on the host's GPU (AMD or Intel through Vulkan). The music recipe (ACE-Step, used by Flowtunes) is about 7.6 GiB of weights plus a 380 MiB image, downloaded when you set it up; nothing is fetched at install time.
Rootless Podman needs subordinate ids for your user: a line for it in /etc/subuid and /etc/subgid (Debian adds them when the user is created; check with `grep $USER /etc/subuid /etc/subgid`).

There is no systemd user manager on Devuan: each running model is a supervisor process (omaxian_units.py) that restarts it on failure. Models do not start at login; start one with `omarchy-agent-local start <recipe>`.
Not ported: Spark pairing (link/pair), sharing over a tailnet (share/network/forget) and the NVIDIA CDI path. Their commands are removed.
